schema.name: id
schema.description: Original identifier trimmed when a string, or converted from an integer.

schema.name: amount
schema.description: Positive amount in major currency units, exactly representable to two decimal places.

schema.name: currency
schema.description: Uppercase three-letter code; supported values are USD and EUR.

schema.name: timestamp
schema.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp ending in Z, with nonzero fractional seconds preserved.

schema.name: status
schema.description: One of SUCCESS, FAILED, or PENDING.

schema.name: source
schema.description: Detected input format: format_a, format_b, or format_c.

source_detection.method: A record must be a JSON object containing every exact required key for exactly one format. Additional keys are allowed. Key values are validated separately.
source_detection.ambiguous: Separate as invalid with an Ambiguous source format error; do not prioritize a format.
source_detection.unknown: Separate as invalid with an Unknown or incomplete source format error.

amount_rules.format_a: amount is in major currency units; for example, 100.50 means 100.50.
amount_rules.format_b: total is a JSON number of integer minor currency units; for example, 10050 means 100.50 major units. Fractional minor-unit values and string totals are rejected.
amount_rules.format_c: amount is in major currency units; a leading € symbol means EUR (for example, €99,99 means 99.99 EUR).
amount_rules.major_unit_inputs: Accept JSON numbers and numeric strings. Strings may use one period or one comma as the decimal separator; thousands separators are not supported. Reject mixed or repeated separators, embedded spaces, scientific notation in strings, booleans, null, non-finite values, unsupported symbols, and malformed numeric strings. Trim surrounding whitespace. A single leading $ or € symbol is allowed.
amount_rules.precision: USD and EUR support two decimal places. Accept extra trailing zeros, reject amounts that would require rounding, and normalize to two decimal places internally.
amount_rules.valid_range: Amounts must be greater than zero. Zero and negative amounts are invalid.

currency_rules.normalization: Trim surrounding whitespace and uppercase explicit codes.
currency_rules.format_c: Infer currency only from a recognized leading amount symbol.
currency_rules.fallback: For format_a and format_b, a missing, null, or blank currency value may be supplied by a recognized amount symbol. The currency key must still be present for source detection.
currency_rules.invalid_cases: An explicit nonempty unsupported code is invalid even when a symbol is present. A code/symbol conflict is invalid. If neither a supported explicit code nor a recognized symbol resolves currency, the record is invalid.

status_rules.normalization: Require a string, trim surrounding whitespace, and lowercase before lookup.
status_rules.unknown_or_missing: Invalid; do not guess or default to PENDING.

format_b.interpretation: Day first; 10/03/2025 14:22 means March 10, 2025. Set seconds to 00.

format_c.accepted_format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss±HH:mm; optional fractional seconds of one to six digits.

date_rules.output: UTC ISO 8601 ending in Z. Preserve nonzero fractional seconds to six digits and remove trailing zeros.
date_rules.invalid_cases: Trim surrounding whitespace; reject impossible dates, invalid times, missing/blank/non-string values, unsupported formats, Unix timestamps, and date-only values. Do not guess.

validation.id: Accept a nonblank string (trim it) or an integer excluding booleans (convert it to text). Reject missing, null, blank, fractional, boolean, array, and object IDs. Do not generate IDs.
validation.record: Must match exactly one supported source format by required-key presence; extra keys are allowed.
validation.invalid_record: If any criterion fails, do not include a partially normalized transaction in the valid collection.
validation.collect_reasons: Preserve all validation reasons that can be reliably determined and continue with later records.
validation.original_position: Preserve the input-array position for every entry; expose a one-based position in the interface and a zero-based index in metadata.

duplicates.key: (source, normalized id), compared case-sensitively within one imported file.
duplicates.retention: Keep the first otherwise-valid occurrence in input order.
duplicates.later_occurrence: Separate each later otherwise-valid occurrence as invalid with a Duplicate transaction error referencing the retained record's one-based input position.
duplicates.invalid_earlier_record: A record that fails validation does not reserve its duplicate key.
duplicates.dataset_scope: A new import starts duplicate tracking from scratch.

invalid_record_policy.handling: Separate invalid and incomplete records from valid normalized transactions; do not silently discard them.
invalid_record_policy.preserve: Retain the original parsed JSON record, input position, detected source when identifiable, available identifier, and all reliably determined validation reasons.
invalid_record_policy.file_level_failure: Malformed JSON or an unsupported top-level structure does not replace the currently loaded dataset.

metrics.total_processed: Every entry in a successfully imported JSON array, including invalid entries and duplicates.
metrics.valid: Records that pass validation and remain after duplicate handling.
metrics.invalid: Rejected entries, including incomplete, unknown/ambiguous, non-object, and duplicate records.
metrics.status_counts: Count valid retained records only. Show SUCCESS, FAILED, and PENDING, including zero counts.
metrics.currency_totals: Label as Successful transaction totals by currency. Sum only valid retained SUCCESS transactions, separately for USD and EUR. Exclude FAILED, PENDING, invalid, and duplicate records.
metrics.overview_scope: Always describe the entire currently loaded dataset and do not change with transaction-table filters. Label Full dataset overview.
metrics.filter_scope: Filters affect only the transaction list and its Matching valid transactions result count.
metrics.empty_dataset: An empty array is a successful import with zero counts and totals.
